name: Sentry
description: Sentry lets agents search recent errors, inspect stack traces and affected releases, and summarize what broke after a deploy. Each user signs in to their own Sentry account through the browser.

prompts.text: What new errors appeared since yesterday's deploy?
Explain the top crash in the mobile project and its likely cause.
How healthy is the current release compared to the last one?

apps.name: Sentry
apps.description: Error search, issue inspection, and release health, over Sentry's MCP server with browser sign-in.
